ei.title: Economic Benefits of a Common Currency
ei.subject: 6월_2026 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Economic Benefits of a Common Currency

fullPassage: Many of the barriers to trade exist not because of a lack of markets or customers, but because there are major barriers to getting products to market at competitive prices. Transaction costs are significant for companies — not only the straight exchange costs, but also the cost of converting, paying, and hedging funds just to pay for the goods and services. Having a common currency means that many of those transaction costs disappear and the savings can be reinvested back into firms' productivity and innovation. Basically, useless costs turn into productive costs — with longer-term benefits to the whole economy. By unifying some of the currencies, whole economies benefit and grow more than they would as independents. So a common currency provides for a strong economic foundation that all can benefit from.

questions.passage: Many of the (A)[barriers / bridges] to trade exist not because of a lack of markets or customers, but because there are major barriers to getting products to market at (B)[competitive / cooperative] prices. Transaction costs are significant for companies — not only the straight exchange costs, but also the cost of converting, paying, and hedging funds just to pay for the goods and services. Having a common currency means that many of those transaction costs disappear and the savings can be (C)[reinvested / redistributed] back into firms' productivity and innovation. Basically, useless costs turn into productive costs — with longer-term benefits to the whole economy. By unifying some of the currencies, whole economies benefit and grow more than they would as independents. So a common currency provides for a strong economic foundation that all can benefit from.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① bridges(다리) — competitive(경쟁력 있는) — reinvested(재투자된): bridges ≠ barriers(장벽)
✅ ② barriers(장벽) — competitive(경쟁력 있는) — reinvested(재투자된): 원문 일치 ← 정답
❌ ③ barriers(장벽) — cooperative(협력적인) — reinvested(재투자된): cooperative ≠ competitive(경쟁력 있는)
❌ ④ barriers(장벽) — competitive(경쟁력 있는) — redistributed(재분배된): redistributed ≠ reinvested(재투자된)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

❌ ② insignificant(중요하지 않은) — disappear(사라지다) — productive(생산적인): insignificant ≠ significant(상당한)
❌ ③ significant(상당한) — increase(증가하다) — productive(생산적인): increase ≠ disappear(사라지다)
❌ ④ significant(상당한) — disappear(사라지다) — destructive(파괴적인): destructive ≠ productive(생산적인)

❌ ④ hedging(위험회피) — innovation(혁신) — limitation(제한): limitation ≠ foundation(기반)
